title: NeighborWorks Laredo Building 24 Affordable Homes; Two Complete, One Priced at $138,000 With City Grant
excerpt: NeighborWorks Laredo is building 24 affordable homes for low- to moderate-income families, and two are already complete — one of them marked down to $138,000 with a $50,000 grant from the City of Laredo.
content:
NeighborWorks Laredo is building 24 affordable homes for low- to moderate-income families in Laredo, and two of the homes are already complete, according to a report on the project.

One of the finished homes is marked down to $138,000 with a $50,000 grant from the City of Laredo, bringing the price down from $188,000. Each home in the project is 1,000 square feet with three bedrooms and two bathrooms.

NeighborWorks Laredo, a nonprofit community development organization, also offers homebuying classes that walk participants through the purchase process step by step. Graduates receive a certificate they can use to apply for down payment assistance programs.

The schedule for the remaining 22 homes, and whether other homes in the project will receive similar subsidies, has not been announced.

Sources: Wisevoter, Nov. 17, 2026.
